Run from the repository root with:
    python -m unittest .swarm-contributions/e4908122df7eddbf/auto-work-e4908122df7eddbf-2-1.txt

The filename may instead be copied to test_csv_tool.py and run normally.
"""

import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest


SCRIPT = Path.cwd() / "csv_tool.py"
if not SCRIPT.is_file():
    raise RuntimeError(f"csv_tool.py not found at {SCRIPT}")

_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("csv_tool_under_test", SCRIPT)
if _SPEC is None or _SPEC.loader is None:
    raise RuntimeError("could not load csv_tool.py")
csv_tool = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
_SPEC.loader.exec_module(csv_tool)


class ParseRecordsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_01_simple_records(self):
        text = "name,note\nAda,hello\nBob,goodbye\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            csv_tool.parse_records(text),
            [{"name": "Ada", "note": "hello"}, {"name": "Bob", "note": "goodbye"}],
        )

    def test_02_quoted_comma(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAda,"one, two"\n'),
            [{"name": "Ada", "note": "one, two"}],
        )

    def test_03_doubled_quotes(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\n"A ""nickname""","She said ""hi"""\n'),
            [{"name": 'A "nickname"', "note": 'She said "hi"'}],
        )

    def test_04_embedded_newlines(self):
        text = 'name,note\nAda,"line one\nline two"\n'
        self.assertEqual(
            csv_tool.parse_records(text),
            [{"name": "Ada", "note": "line one\nline two"}],
        )

    def test_05_crlf_input(self):
        text = 'name,note\r\nAda,"first\r\nsecond"\r\nBob,ok\r\n'
        self.assertEqual(
            csv_tool.parse_records(text),
            [
                {"name": "Ada", "note": "first\r\nsecond"},
                {"name": "Bob", "note": "ok"},
            ],
        )

    def test_06_unicode_and_empty_fields(self):
        text = "name,note\n雪,☃️\n,blank name\nblank note,\n,\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            csv_tool.parse_records(text),
            [
                {"name": "雪", "note": "☃️"},
                {"name": "", "note": "blank name"},
                {"name": "blank note", "note": ""},
                {"name": "", "note": ""},
            ],
        )

    def test_07_missing_header(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records("")

    def test_08_wrong_or_reordered_header(self):
        for text in ("note,name\nx,y\n", "Name,note\nx,y\n", "name,notes\nx,y\n"):
            with self.subTest(text=text), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                csv_tool.parse_records(text)

    def test_09_header_with_extra_column(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records("name,note,other\nx,y,z\n")

    def test_10_unterminated_quoted_field(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAda,"never closed\n')

    def test_11_quote_inside_unquoted_field(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAd"a,hello\n')

    def test_12_characters_after_closing_quote(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\n"Ada"junk,hello\n')

    def test_13_too_few_columns(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records("name,note\nAda\n")

    def test_14_too_many_columns(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records("name,note\nAda,hello,extra\n")


class FormatRecordsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_15_simple_output_has_header_and_lf_terminators(self):
        result = csv_tool.format_records([{"name": "Ada", "note": "hello"}])
        self.assertEqual(result, "name,note\nAda,hello\n")
        self.assertNotIn("\r", result)

    def test_16_quoting_and_round_trip_preserve_strings(self):
        records = [
            {"name": 'A, "B"', "note": "first\nsecond"},
            {"name": "雪", "note": ""},
        ]
        encoded = csv_tool.format_records(records)
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.parse_records(encoded), records)
        self.assertNotIn("\r\n", encoded)

    def test_17_missing_key_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.format_records([{"name": "Ada"}])

    def test_18_extra_key_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.format_records([{"name": "Ada", "note": "hi", "extra": "x"}])

    def test_19_non_string_values_rejected(self):
        invalid_records = (
            {"name": 1, "note": "hi"},
            {"name": "Ada", "note": None},
            {"name": "Ada", "note": ["hi"]},
        )
        for record in invalid_records:
            with self.subTest(record=record), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                csv_tool.format_records([record])


class JsonAndCliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_20_to_json_is_valid_and_preserves_values(self):
        text = 'name,note\n"A,雪","line one\nline ""two"""\n'
        result = csv_tool.to_json(text)
        self.assertIsInstance(result, str)
        self.assertEqual(
            json.loads(result),
            [{"name": "A,雪", "note": 'line one\nline "two"'}],
        )

    def test_21_cli_success_writes_only_json_and_exits_zero(self):
        text = 'name,note\r\n雪,"hello, world"\r\n'
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(SCRIPT)],
            input=text,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
        )
        self.assertEqual(completed.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(completed.stderr, "")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(completed.stdout), [{"name": "雪", "note": "hello, world"}])
        self.assertEqual(completed.stdout.strip(), completed.stdout.rstrip("\n"))

    def test_22_cli_invalid_input_uses_stderr_without_traceback(self):
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(SCRIPT)],
            input="wrong,header\nx,y\n",
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
        )
        self.assertEqual(completed.returncode, 2)
        self.assertEqual(completed.stdout, "")
        self.assertTrue(completed.stderr.strip())
        self.assertNotIn("Traceback", completed.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn("Traceback", completed.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
